figurative_meaning_en: To learn through painful or direct experience
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অনেকবার ভুল করে কানমলা খেয়েছে, এখন সবকিছু বুঝতে পারে।
জীবনের কঠিন পাঠ থেকে কানমলা খেয়ে সে পরিপক্ক হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has eaten earwax many times by making mistakes; now he understands everything.
Through life's hard lessons, he has eaten earwax and become mature.
note: This idiom evokes the discomfort of self-inflicted learning, akin to the gross act of eating earwax as a metaphor for bitter experiences.
